column1: # AUROC of mean_zvf vs binary failure targets:
#   is_collapse_or_drift   positive class = collapse or drift
# Bootstrap CIs: B=2000 percentile resamples over per-cell pooled
# rows (NOT per-step rows, which are autocorrelated).
# AUROC > 0.5 = higher ZVF is more failure-like.
# The pooled 'all' AUROC collapses both bimodal failure modes
# (drift at LOW ZVF, collapse at HIGH ZVF) into a single number,
# so it sits near 0.5; the per-stratum CIs expose the bimodality.
